entities.summary: Linda Anne Chapman is a British writer, principally of series for younger children. She is particularly known for her fantasy books about unicorns, mermaids and magic and has co-authored books with Julie Sykes, Michelle Misra, Lee Weatherly and Steve Cole. She also writes the Superpowers series as Alex Cliff. She has written several of the series books published under the names Lucy Daniels, Jenny Dale, Daisy Meadows, Rosie Banks Katie Chase, Amber Castle, Astrid Foss, Tilda Kelly, Posy Diamond and Lauren Brooke, either as part of a collective pseudonym or as a ghostwriter.
